payload.title: The only contradiction writer fires for a withdrawn belief, whose confidence _record_belief refuses to update, so the arbiter's ruling can never land, the contradiction row is never closed and its HIGH pressure counts forever (latent until an operator withdraws a belief that an adapter keeps emitting)
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:1578-1587 (the only _record_contradiction call is for a candidate whose belief is withdrawn)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:610-613 (_record_belief returns a withdrawn belief unchanged before _feedback_adjustment is read)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:1897-1912 (the only place a ruling's affected_belief_ids moves confidence)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/belief_escalation.py:179-199 (the arbiter fold writes the ruling with affected_belief_ids for that belief)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/memory.py:423-451 (unwithdraw_belief, the only way back, has no non-test caller and no CLI verb)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/pressure.py:343-363 (status open contradictions raise a high CONTRADICTION pressure; no code closes a row)
payload.rule_violated: A closed channel needs its last hop: belief_escalation.py:21-26 claims the loop is closed end to end, but it holds only for a belief a person un-withdrew by hand, for which no verb exists.
payload.notes: An operator withdraws a belief that discovery adapters re-emit every cycle; each cycle appends a contradiction row (status open). After three cycles the arbiter is asked once and its false_positive ruling is folded as feedback with affected_belief_ids, but memory._record_belief returns the withdrawn row at line 611 before the adjustment is applied. The belief never changes, the rows never close, and the CONTRADICTION pressure (severity high) stays open every cycle. Latent today: it needs an operator withdraw first. Close condition: Either the ruling or an operator verb closes the contradiction rows and clears the pressure, or the contradiction is not minted for a withdrawn belief; a test withdraws a belief, re-emits it for three cycles, folds a ruling and asserts that the CONTRADICTION pressure clears or the stored confidence changes (red today). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
